derived: Converted from the 1.1.6 golden script (edf11eb) through Documentation/protocol/legacy_map.json. Request for request identical to the translated replay recorded on an RP2350 on 2026-11-16, less the requests the translation answered locally and duplicate reads. Entries with origin native were added in the paged protocol and have no 1.1.6 counterpart.
note: Paged requests. dir G is a GET of len bytes, S a SET of payload (hex). settle waits after the request: delay_ms, then poll ready (SYS.PLATFORM answers) or cs (CS.STATUS byte 0 leaves PENDING).
